label: Restore preparation stages and readiness audit from history

execute.description: Recover readiness timestamps only from actual READY history
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."order" o SET "readyAt" = h.ready FROM (SELECT "orderId", MIN("createdAt") AS ready FROM "public"."orderStatusHistory" WHERE "toStatus" = 'READY' GROUP BY "orderId") h WHERE o.id = h."orderId" AND o."readyAt" IS NULL

execute.description: Audit and restore active LATE rows; missing history conservatively resumes at NEW
execute.sql: WITH stages AS (SELECT o.id, COALESCE((SELECT h."fromStatus" FROM "public"."orderStatusHistory" h WHERE h."orderId" = o.id AND h."toStatus" = 'LATE' AND h."fromStatus" IN ('NEW','ACCEPTED','IN_PREPARATION','READY') ORDER BY h."createdAt" DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT 1), 'NEW') AS stage, GREATEST(o."updatedAt", (SELECT MAX(h."createdAt") FROM "public"."orderStatusHistory" h WHERE h."orderId" = o.id)) + interval '1 millisecond' AS at FROM "public"."order" o WHERE o.status = 'LATE'), audit AS (INSERT INTO "public"."orderStatusHistory" (id,"orderId","fromStatus","toStatus","changedByUserId",reason,"createdAt") SELECT gen_random_uuid(), id, 'LATE', stage, NULL, 'Migracija: vraćen prethodni tok pripreme; kašnjenje i popust ostaju zabeleženi.', at FROM stages) UPDATE "public"."order" o SET status = s.stage FROM stages s WHERE o.id = s.id

execute.description: Expose legacy deliveries whose original provider payload is unavailable
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."orderNotificationDelivery" SET status = 'FAILED', "leaseUntil" = NULL, "lastErrorCode" = 'EMAIL_ORIGINAL_PAYLOAD_UNAVAILABLE' WHERE payload IS NULL AND status IN ('PENDING','FAILED','SENDING')
